reviews.title: “I bought a real hearing aid. This app does more for me.”
reviews.body: “Bought a hearing aid. It didn't do much. Found this app, spent a couple days on the settings, and that was it — my hearing aid. Works great with my Bose over-ears.”
reviews.author: Wolfgang

reviews.title: “My grandpa hears again — with the AirPods he already had.”
reviews.body: “Grandpa had trouble hearing. I put this on his phone and now he just uses his AirPods as a hearing aid. Big thanks to the devs for making something that actually changes people's lives.”
reviews.author: Eleni

reviews.title: “Bought it to hear better. Found tinnitus relief too.”
reviews.body: “Bought the app for mild hearing loss and use the amplification every day. Then I noticed it also has tinnitus therapy — a huge relief, since I get ringing too. I use it whenever it comes back.”
reviews.author: Robert

reviews.title: “Few months in and it still works great.”
reviews.body: “Been using this a few months and it works great. One hiccup when I renewed — the payment went through, then it said my subscription had expired, even though I'd paid for three months. Sorted now, I think!”
reviews.author: Keiko
